title: Mediterranean Cruise
name: Mediterranean Cruise
stays: Norwegian Epic · Balcony stateroom · From Barcelona
p1: Seven days at sea from Barcelona aboard the Norwegian Epic, calling at Provence, Nice and Monaco, Florence and Pisa, Sicily, Salerno and Rome. You wake in a new port, and every evening ends on your own balcony.
p2: Round-trip airfare from your home airport, a night in Barcelona and every transfer are included. Onboard, the open bar, dining, Wi-Fi and gratuities are already taken care of.
storyImg: A flower-lined terrace above the sea in Amalfi
presImg: An arched window framing the Amalfi Coast
presText: Your balcony stateroom is your private window on the Mediterranean. Between ports there is a day at sea for the spa, the pool deck or a long lunch, plus three specialty dining meals.
wideImg: Positano and its tiled dome above a bay of yachts
